_comment: Assisto AI INBOX (feature 22) BASIC->ADVANCED upgrade, SPEC v2.1 Section 21. {key:[bn,en]}: index [0]=bn -> app_bn.arb, [1]=en -> app_en.arb. camelCase getters map 1:1 to tr.* used by inbox_screen.dart + widgets/inbox_*.dart. One parameterized key inboxSelectedCount uses ICU {count}; its @-metadata block (placeholders:{count:{type:Object}}) must be added to BOTH .arb files. Bangla digits (the selected count) are rendered at runtime from codepoints in Dart intl, no Bangla literals in .dart. REUSED existing getters (do NOT re-add): aiInbox, checkInternetRetry, retry. Merge both arbs then flutter gen-l10n.
